title: Winkworth profits to fall materially due to legal costs
summary:
Estate agency franchise Winkworth has warned that legal and advisory costs will materially reduce its full-year 2026 profits below current market expectations. The company incurred £105,000 in legal costs during the first half of 2026, with a further £376,000 committed up to September.

title: Estate agents face rising financial distress levels
summary:
The number of real estate and property services companies in financial distress has increased, with 7,641 businesses in 'critical' distress during Q2 2026, up 6.8% year-on-year. Estate agents saw an 11.1% rise in critical distress levels, reaching 411 firms.

title: Lomond acquires FHP Living lettings arm in Nottingham
summary:
Lomond has acquired the residential lettings and property management division of Nottingham-based FHP Living. The acquired business will be integrated into John Shepherd, Lomond's primary brand operating across the Midlands.

title: Property investor acquires Belvoir franchise in Stafford
summary:
Property investor and former finance director David Slann has acquired Belvoir Stone and Stafford through a franchise resale. The transaction marks his move from portfolio management to agency operations, with plans to expand the managed portfolio and develop residential sales.

title: North East properties reach exchange fastest in England
summary:
The North East has recorded the fastest property transaction times in England, with 58.4% of sales progressing to exchange within three months. Analysis by TwentyEA found lower-priced properties and freehold tenure also correlated with faster completion rates.

title: UK property auction sales rise in 12 of 13 regions
summary:
Residential property auction sales increased across 12 of the UK's 13 regions during the first half of 2026, according to new data from EIG's Property Auction Insights report. The figures reveal a broadening market with flats accounting for an increasing share of transactions, while average sale prices varied significantly across regions.

title: Illegal cannabis farms drive £9.4m in property claims
summary:
Landlords are facing substantial financial losses from illegal cannabis cultivation operations, with insurers reporting £9.4 million in claims since January 2022. Fire and rescue service callouts to suspected cannabis farms rose 218% between 2015 and 2024.

title: Help-to-buy review finds £25bn social value delivered
summary:
A government audit of the help-to-buy programme has calculated it provided £25bn of social value to the UK in the last financial year, supporting over 387,000 home purchases. The findings come as debate continues within government over whether Labour should introduce its own version of the scheme.

title: LSL reports 3% revenue growth despite transaction decline
summary:
LSL Property Services has reported a 3% increase in group revenue to £92.3 million for the first half of the year, despite a 4% decline in property transactions. The parent company of Reeds Rains and Your Move recorded an 11% rise in underlying operating profit to £15.9 million, attributing its resilience to diversified income streams.
